events.title: Telangana unveils 2024–2027 AI strategy
events.date_basis: Contemporaneous article says Thursday at the summit's inaugural session; this is 5 September, not the article's 6 September IST publication date.
events.summary: The state released a six-pillar AI roadmap covering public services, local data, skills, compute access and an AI City.
events.limitations: Targets for 2027 are prospective. Strategy publication is not proof that individual programmes or an AI City were delivered; aggregator's 6 September launch date rejected.

events.title: Telangana and Google sign cross-sector AI MoU
events.date_basis: Both fetched reports identify Thursday 13 February and the MoU exchange.
events.summary: The government and Google signed an MoU for AI applications in agriculture, mobility, education, sustainability and governance.
events.limitations: Both news reports appear to draw on the same announcement; they are duplicate coverage, not independent impact validation. MoU signing does not prove deployment.

events.title: Microsoft and Telangana sign AI skilling and centre-of-excellence agreement
events.date_basis: Report published 14 February says the signing and event were Thursday, 13 February.
events.summary: A signed MoU covers AI training programmes and a proposed centre of excellence with cloud infrastructure and an AI knowledge hub.
events.limitations: Training 120,000 people and establishing the centre are announced commitments. The Microsoft office inauguration is not treated as opening the AI centre.

events.title: BuildNow AI-assisted building approvals expand to HMDA
events.date_basis: Fetched 19 April article says extension occurred on Friday, 18 April; official platform archive also lists the expansion.
events.summary: Telangana extended its AI-assisted building-approval service from GHMC to the wider Hyderabad Metropolitan Development Authority region.
events.limitations: Operational means a publicly documented rollout, not an independent performance audit. Claims about seconds-long scrutiny must not be generalized to end-to-end legal approvals; later DTCP plans are not counted here.

events.title: TGDeX data and AI platform launches
events.date_basis: Contemporaneous report explicitly dates Wednesday's launch to 2 July; implementing partner confirms July 2025.
events.summary: The state launched TGDeX to provide datasets, AI models and development resources for public-sector innovation.
events.limitations: Dataset counts conflict: contemporary news says 500+ and an undated partner page says 1,000+ at launch. No harmonized inventory count or AI impact claim is inferred.

events.title: Telangana signs Blaize MoU for AI and semiconductor collaboration
events.date_basis: Official release dated 21 January 2026 describes the finalized MoU; updated 22 January.
events.summary: At Davos, Telangana signed an MoU with Blaize covering advanced AI capabilities, R&D expansion support and exploration of sectoral applications.
events.limitations: Potential healthcare, manufacturing and energy pilots were discussed, not reported as implemented. Existing Hyderabad R&D activity is not counted as a new state deployment.

events.title: Uttar Pradesh signs Google Cloud agriculture-network MoU
events.date_basis: 8 January newspaper clipping explicitly says signing was Tuesday, 7 January; web article has a later update timestamp.
events.summary: The state signed an agreement for a Gemini-powered open agricultural network connecting farmers with advisory and other services.
events.limitations: Headline says launch, but body establishes an MoU; stage conservatively recorded as signed. Government-hosted newspaper clipping is the same reporting, not independent primary corroboration. Benefits are intended.

events.title: AI Pragya skilling initiative launches
events.date_basis: Article body explicitly gives Friday, 9 May 2025; article publication was 10 May.
events.summary: The Chief Minister launched AI Pragya in Lucknow to expand AI and digital skills, with a stated target of training one million young people.
events.limitations: Programme launch does not establish training completion, learner outcomes or World Bank financing specifically earmarked for AI Pragya.

events.title: AI-linked Agritech Innovation Hub opens at SVPUAT Meerut
events.date_basis: PIB release Posted On 8 July 2025 says inaugurated today.
events.summary: SVPUAT Meerut and IIT Ropar inaugurated an agritech hub linked to ANNAM.AI and signed an MoU for research and field deployment.
events.limitations: Included because SVPUAT is a state agricultural university and state ministers participated; central–state institutional collaboration, not a solely state-funded project. No farmer-impact measurement inferred.

events.title: UPDESCO and IndiaAI sign Data and AI Labs MoU
events.date_basis: Later parliamentary answer expressly dates execution to 26 September 2025; 24 July 2026 is the answer date.
events.summary: UPDESCO and IndiaAI signed an agreement to establish AI/data-skills labs in government ITIs.
events.limitations: PIB also reports an MoU ceremony on 12 January 2026 without identifying whether it renewed or expanded the September instrument; not counted as a second signing. Lab totals vary by date/scope (49, 62, 64); no operational census inferred.

events.title: Chief Minister announces Uttar Pradesh AI Mission
events.date_basis: Official release Posted On 12 January 2026 describes that day's announcement.
events.summary: The Chief Minister announced a state AI Mission at Lucknow's regional AI conference, with an approximately ₹2,000 crore programme described in the release.
events.limitations: ₹2,000 crore is the announcement's programme-scale figure, not evidence of annual appropriation or expenditure. Later annual budget provision and Cabinet approval are separate milestones.

events.title: Invest UP and AM Group sign proposed 1 GW AI-compute hub MoU
events.date_basis: Both government and company releases explicitly date the Davos signing 20 January 2026.
events.summary: Invest UP and AM Group signed an agreement for a proposed 1 GW AI-compute hub in Greater Noida.
events.initiative: AM Group Greater Noida AI compute hub
events.limitations: Official schedules conflict: Invest UP targets full capacity by 2028; AM Group says first capacity 2028 and full 1 GW by 2030. Planned ~$25 billion investment is a partner commitment, not state spending or completed capacity.

events.title: FY2026–27 budget proposes ₹225 crore for the AI Mission
events.date_basis: Budget document establishes amounts; fetched contemporaneous reporting expressly dates budget presentation to 11 February 2026.
events.summary: The state budget provided ₹225 crore for the AI Mission and separately ₹32.82 crore for AI labs and a centre of excellence.
events.limitations: Budget presentation/provision is not proof of appropriation passage, release or expenditure. Do not add the ₹2,000 crore mission announcement to these annual provisions; ₹2,059 crore is the whole IT/electronics sector, not AI.

events.title: Cabinet approves Uttar Pradesh Artificial Intelligence Mission
events.date_basis: 10 October article says Cabinet approved it on Friday, which was 9 October 2026.
events.summary: Cabinet approved UP-AIM with an institutional structure, AI infrastructure and skilling plans, and proposed safeguards for high-impact government uses.
events.limitations: Cabinet approval verified from fetched reporting, not the underlying order. Startup, training and district-centre numbers are targets; proposed trust and assurance framework is not treated as an enacted regulatory instrument.

notes: Research window: 2024-01-01 through 2026-11-10 inclusive. Six Telangana and eight Uttar Pradesh distinct milestones, not a comprehensive census.
Event dates are normalized separately from article publication dates. Primary documents and article-body dates outrank upload paths, search metadata and current template banners.
Primary government statements and corporate statements establish reported commitments, not effectiveness. Confidence grades concern factual occurrence and attribution only.

Duplicates: Google Telangana two outlets collapse into one MoU; Uttar Pradesh Google web story and Invest UP clipping are the same original publisher; TGDeX partner and news describe one launch; AM Group and Invest UP describe one signing.

Same-initiative milestones retained separately: UP AI Mission January announcement, February annual budget provision, October Cabinet approval. Counts must not be interpreted as number of independent programmes.

Retrieval performed with Tavily and Exa; Firecrawl attempt failed for zero credits. Tavily returned 429 on a later extraction batch; fallback Exa succeeded on relevant Telangana sources. Full retrieved pages were read; only short evidence excerpts and paraphrases are retained.
Search coverage is English-led with a bilingual Telangana official release. Missing activity is not absence of policy, and no outcome league table is justified.
Important unresolved conflicts: AM Group compute hub 2028 vs 2030 full-capacity target; TGDeX launch inventory 500+ vs 1000+; UP labs MoU execution versus later ceremony. Retained explicitly.
Six Telangana records include no standalone AI-specific budget figure: ₹774 crore in state IT budget is sector-wide, not valid as AI allocation.
